description: Known test failures for the EXTERNAL .NET FhirPath Validator (fhirpath-validator.exe), consumed by the 'Run FhirPath Validation with FHIR Test Cases' and 'Audit conformance coverage' steps in .github/workflows/ci.yml via --known-failures. It describes that harness running against the separately checked-out FHIR/fhir-test-cases@master corpus — NOT the vendored tests-fhir-r5.xml in this directory, and NOT the in-process Rust suite in crates/fhirpath/tests/r5_tests.rs. Those two harnesses have genuinely different pass sets (txTest03 is a declared failure here and passes in-process; the HTMLChecks group does not exist in the vendored corpus at all), so the Rust suite reads its own rust-known-failures.json instead. The schema is identical between the two files so an entry can be copy-pasted when a limitation affects both. See issue #307.

knownFailures.reason: Output type fidelity: '.value.code' returns FHIR type 'string' instead of 'code' ('Mismatch at index 0: expected type code, got string'). The translation itself succeeds and returns the expected 'H'. Same limitation as testContainedId. The previous reason ('ConceptMap cm-address-use-v2 not available on test server') was wrong on both servers: tx.fhir.org and hts.heliossoftware.com each resolve this ConceptMap.
Decimal trailing zeros not preserved (known limitation)
conformsTo not yet implemented. The server answers 501, so these tests are absent from the results JSON rather than recorded as failures.

htmlChecks() not yet implemented. The server answers 501, so these tests are absent from the results JSON rather than recorded as failures. Previously undeclared: they were invisible because the runner's exit code ignores not-implemented tests (#287).
